description: This file defines the PressVibratorV1 class, a specific implementation of a press vibrator for Android devices, extending the base PressVibrator class. It manages vibration durations for normal and long presses and triggers device vibration accordingly.

classes.name: PressVibratorV1
classes.description: A class that manages vibration durations and triggers vibrations for press events, extending the base PressVibrator class.

methods.name: PressVibratorV1
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the vibrator with a given Vibrator object.

methods.name: setDuration
methods.description: Sets the duration for a normal press vibration.

methods.name: setLongPressDuration
methods.description: Sets the duration for a long press vibration.

methods.name: vibrate
methods.description: Triggers the vibration based on whether the press is long or normal, considering suppression checks.
